Added an RCS attitude controller to the flight computer. This replaces the old "snap to" cheaty buttons with actual controller targets. Using the flight computer physics integration, this controller is stable at all time warp levels and tracks its targets fairly efficiently. There is a lot more work to do on UI and jet selection work in the future, but at the moment this is quite usable.
Choosing a new pointing target now automatically switches the navball view to the appropriate frame.

Added a MinimumPulseTime to Thrusters in the XML, which is now enforced by the simulation. This mimics real-life reaction control thrusters which have a "minimum impulse bit" and drives much of the structure of RCS controllers.

Improved the calculation of thrust when thrusters are active for less than an entire timestep. Previously we were discounting thrust by approximately half due to how our second-order integrator was sampling the derivatives.
Randomly sample thruster plumes at higher time warps to help reduce cases where lots of small pulses over a long period of time visually appear to be continuous thrust.

Increase the sophistication of the burn computer by using 3D delta velocity targets and recomputing burn attitude continuously. This logic is still more on the janky side because the burn loading/unloading isn't fully baked and there are pieces that still live in Vehicle which need to be extracted in another pass.
Added serialization to the flight computer.
Enforce the minimum flight computer wakeup times more rigorously so that we don't dispatch the computer e.g. on every ground collision tick.
Corrected a significant error in physics rails handoff logic where going into freefall would always send you to the end of the current update rather than obeying the proposed intra-step delta time.

Simplified the placement of the call to put vehicles back on rails so that it always happens at the beginning of a step rather than potentially at the end. This makes finalization actions for each step uniform.
Renamed NavBallMode to VehicleReferenceFrame and moved it into its own file, along with the functions to compute various attitude-related quantities.
Changed several debug asserts into exceptions in the physics system.
Added a MassRateReference template.
Changed the stabilization toggle key into a proper input action.
Made the various VLF frame computations in StateVectors properly return nullable values for when this frame is undefined.
Moved several debug setting flags off of every individual Vehicle and into static flags in Program.
